pages.title: Voxhalla
pages.creator: BossByte
pages.description: Land on a voxel island in Voxhalla and move, jump, or dash to stay ahead of the monsters. Your weapons fire automatically, so focus on collecting experience and choosing upgrades as you level up. Spend the silver you earn after each run on permanent improvements and new survivors.

pages.title: Candy Sort
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Sort candies by color in Candy Sort. Move a candy into an empty tube or onto another of the same color, and plan your transfers while the clock is running. If you need help, the reward options can add another tube or stop the timer.

pages.title: Solitaire Witch
pages.creator: Playades International LLC
pages.description: Play Spider Solitaire with the Solitaire Witch. Arrange cards in descending order and build complete runs from king to ace to remove them from the table. Look for moves that uncover face-down cards and make room before dealing another set from the stock.

pages.title: Mate in Chess
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Find the move that traps the king in Mate in Chess. Study each position to see which squares the king can still reach, then move a piece to set up checkmate. Later puzzles ask you to think through more combinations before committing to a move.

pages.title: City Gas Station Simulator
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Run a service station in City Gas Station Simulator. Fuel cars at the pumps and take care of customers in the mini shop. Divide your attention between the two jobs as people arrive, and decide what to handle first to keep the station running.

pages.title: Lemonade Tycoon Idle
pages.creator: MHL
pages.description: Start with a small lemonade stand in Lemonade Tycoon Idle. Serve drinks to customers and reinvest your earnings in upgrades or staff. Keep growing the business as day turns to night, then expand beyond the original stand and open up more of the world.

pages.title: Farm Animal Sort Puzzle
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Match farm animals and vegetables to what customers ask for in Farm Animal Sort Puzzle. Look at the available spaces before moving anything and put each item where it belongs. Work through the orders as the sorting layouts give you different groups to organize.

pages.title: Connect Puzzle Image
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Drag picture pieces into place in Connect Puzzle Image. Look for shapes and edges that fit together, then bring the pieces into alignment to reveal the full image. Each puzzle assembles a different subject, from a character or a dish to an everyday object.

pages.title: Find & Steal Brainrot: 67 Game
pages.creator: Mao Games
pages.description: Spot a specific Brainrot character in Find & Steal Brainrot: 67 Game. Scan scenes crowded with figures like Strawberry Elephant and Dragon Cannelloni, and keep looking for the same target even as the surroundings change. Use its shape and colors to pick it out among the other characters.

pages.title: Matching Puzzle
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description: Watch the pictures on falling blocks in Matching Puzzle. They’re covered once the blocks land, so remember where you saw each image and find its match. Make your choices quickly to earn combo points before you lose track of the pictures underneath.

pages.title: Basketball Fever
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Try four shooting challenges in Basketball Fever. Aim for the hoop and adjust your timing based on where the ball lands. Switch between challenges when you want to practice a different shot, or repeat one to see how much you can improve your score.

pages.title: Counter Craft Sniper
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Take up a sniper rifle to protect downtown in Counter Craft Sniper. Aim from rooftops and other high points, then pick out hostile creepers, skeletons, and zombies on the streets below. Keep scanning for the next target as you clear the mobs threatening civilians.

pages.title: Swim Good
pages.creator: LetiArts
pages.description: Swim in circles and eat worms in Swim Good. Watch the spiky urchins and steer away from the shots they send across your path. Keep eating whenever there’s a safe opening and see how long you can stay alive as you circle the area.

pages.title: Hero Transform Race
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Switch superhero forms as you race in Hero Transform Race. Look at the obstacle in front of you and pick a form that can get through it. Change again when the track calls for a different ability and try to reach the end without getting held up.

pages.title: Pictures Riddle
pages.creator: FunFarm
pages.description: Find one word that links four images in Pictures Riddle. Study what the pictures share, then use that connection to guess the word. Switch to Riddles mode for a different kind of clue and work through the hundreds of puzzles at your own pace.

pages.title: Mini Games Puzzle Collection
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Switch between three challenges in Mini Games Puzzle Collection. Build a bridge with limited planks to help a dog reach its bones, draw lines to deliver doughnuts, or run a stall and serve orders. Each activity asks you to work out a different way to get the right item to its destination.

pages.title: Nubik Courier An Open World
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Deliver pizzas around the city in Nubik Courier An Open World. Race the clock as you drive through the streets, dodge obstacles, and switch vehicles when you need another way to get around. Spend money from completed deliveries on upgrades for the next run.

pages.title: My Perfect Mine
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Build a gold mining business in My Perfect Mine. Hire workers and send them underground to extract gold, then use the proceeds to upgrade your crew and put up buildings. Keep expanding the operation until you’ve built a city below ground.

pages.title: Draw And Escape
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Draw a bridge for a yellow car in Draw And Escape, or switch to Parking Jam and work out how to clear the lot. In the drawing puzzles, sketch a route over gaps and steps. In the parking puzzles, choose the order of the cars so they can leave without hitting one another.

pages.title: Paint Master
pages.creator: Depfov
pages.description: Decide which painter should go first in Paint Master. The homeowner has a target pattern, so check how the colors will overlap before sending anyone to work. Match the requested arrangement to finish the level or rethink the order if the painting comes out differently.

pages.title: Epic Hero Quest Idle RPG
pages.creator: AF
pages.description: Fight through groups of enemies in Epic Hero Quest Idle RPG. Earn gold, level up your heroes, and unlock skills to help with later battles. Decide which skills to improve as the fights get tougher and keep building up the hero’s abilities as the quest progresses.

pages.title: Merge Brick Breaker
pages.creator: FluffyFoxGames
pages.description: Break bricks by combining balls in Merge Brick Breaker. Look for chances to merge balls before sending them into the brick formations, and use the space you clear to reach more of the board. Keep balancing upgrades with the need to break through the next group.

pages.title: So Different Dragons
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Raise dragons from birth in So Different Dragons. Tap to make them stronger and speed up their growth, then build up your gold to increase the number of pets in your care. Watch how each dragon changes as it matures.

pages.title: Mini Golf Saga
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Play beachside courses in Mini Golf Saga and try to reach each hole in as few shots as possible. Look at the route before setting your aim, since each level limits how many hits you can take. A reward option can replenish your shots if you need another chance.

pages.title: Dirty Them All
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Drive through muddy puddles in Dirty Them All to splash people walking by the road. The people you hit chase the car, so keep moving toward the finish while looking for more puddles. Bring a bigger crowd along behind you to earn a higher score.

pages.title: Billionaires
pages.creator: Ringier Axel Springer Polska
pages.description: Pick the correct answer from four choices in Billionaires. Read the question and check each option before making your selection. Work through the whole quiz without a wrong answer if you want to reach the main prize.

pages.title: Crazy Design: Rebuild Your Home
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Merge items and use the results to rebuild homes in Crazy Design: Rebuild Your Home. Work through the puzzles to support each renovation, then choose how you want the rooms to look. Take on an existing home or create a different style for a new one.

pages.title: Basketball
pages.creator: SUN.STUDIO
pages.description: Drag to aim and throw the ball in Basketball. Watch how the shot travels toward the hoop and use where it lands to adjust your next throw. Try a different angle or strength when the ball misses so you can guide it through the rim.

pages.title: Clash Of Hive
pages.creator: HolaStudio
pages.description: Take over the hives in Clash Of Hive. Decide which opponent to attack and when to send your forces, keeping track of the hives you already hold. Capture every hive to win the level and move on to another layout.

pages.title: Sprinkle Plants Puzzle Game
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Turn the board to guide water to a plant in Sprinkle Plants Puzzle Game. Look at where the stream will go when you rotate the layout, then adjust the angle until it reaches the plant. Water it enough to grow and complete the puzzle.

pages.title: Squid 2 Glass Bridge
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Remember the green path in Squid 2 Glass Bridge and use it to pick the safe glass panels. Take each step in order, since choosing the wrong panel can break the glass. Cross before the timer ends and try to make it through all 50 levels.

pages.title: Push Noob
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Throw snowballs at a dancing Noob in Push Noob and earn diamonds from the collisions as he falls. Use the diamonds to upgrade Noob and unlock locations or skins. Try different throws to see which ones send him into more objects along the way.

pages.title: Uphill Rush 11
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Race down a cruise ship’s waterslides in Uphill Rush 11. Choose a ride such as an inflatable ring or a water scooter, then pick up speed through the tubes. Make jumps along the way and keep control before you splash into the pool.

pages.title: Boxer.io - Fun io games
pages.creator: XTStudio
pages.description: Knock out other fighters and absorb their power in Boxer.io - Fun io games. Move around the arena to find targets, then use each win to grow bigger and stronger. Avoid getting hit while you work through the remaining fighters and try to be the last one standing.

pages.title: Save the Kitten
pages.creator: AppyApp
pages.description: Catch falling kittens on a trampoline in Save the Kitten. Run beneath the tower and bounce the kittens toward their mother’s basket. Keep watching for the next one as it falls so you can rescue as many as possible.

pages.title: Mad Burger 2
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Launch a burger and see how far it can travel in Mad Burger 2. Watch how the attempt plays out, then use upgrades and bonuses to improve the next launch. Try again with a different setup and see whether the burger can go farther.

pages.title: Among Shooter Kill Impostor
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description: Retake a captured spaceship in Among Shooter Kill Impostor. Use the available weapons to clear enemies of different sizes and abilities, and check above you for impostors moving along the ceiling. Keep fighting until the ship is free and can finish its trip to Earth.

pages.title: Stick Shadow Fighter Legacy
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Help a stickman fight through a dungeon in Stick Shadow Fighter Legacy. Take down robots and watch out for fragile bricks as you move between hazards. Time your jumps so you can stay on the path and make it farther into the dungeon.

pages.title: Block Slide Fall Down
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Slide pieces aside to free the red block in Block Slide Fall Down. Look for moves that open a path without getting another piece stuck in the way. Finish in as few moves as possible to aim for all three stars.

pages.title: Pregnant Rush
pages.creator: OneTwoPlay
pages.description: Collect points as you run through nine months in Pregnant Rush. Keep going along the course until your character reaches the birth at the end. Try different skins and see how the layouts change as you play more levels.

pages.title: Home Makeover 2 Hidden Object
pages.creator: Origaming Media
pages.description: Search an old riverside estate in Home Makeover 2 Hidden Object. Sell the items you find to pay for furniture, help Emma look for the missing deed, and restore the home in Story Mode. Switch to Unlimited Mode when you want to keep searching through the scenes.

pages.title: Drive At Will
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Ride a tricycle through 3D courses in Drive At Will. Drift to charge nitro and use the boost when you have a clear stretch. Pick up shields to protect against obstacles and crashes as you try to set a better record.

pages.title: Funny Faces
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Study a face for five seconds in Funny Faces. Once the preview is gone, drag its features back to where you remember seeing them. Pay attention to how the eyes, nose, and mouth line up, then see how quickly you can rebuild the whole face.

pages.title: Mahjong Connect Deluxe
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Connect matching tiles to clear the board in Mahjong Connect Deluxe. Use extra hints when you can’t find a pair, or freeze the timer when you need longer to look. Spend the coins you collect on different backgrounds and tile designs.

pages.title: Woodturning Art
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Shape wooden objects in Woodturning Art. Cut the wood to create the form you want, then polish the surface and choose how to paint it. See how the finish changes when you use different colors on the piece you’ve shaped.

pages.title: Color Dots
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Press the button that matches the dots in Color Dots. Watch the color of each target and choose the corresponding button to destroy it. Keep checking what’s coming as you go and try to build a higher score on the next run.

pages.title: Kick The Snowman Xmas
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Tap a snowman or use weapons in Kick The Snowman Xmas. Try the different ways to hit him and upgrade the gear as you play. There are eight weapon types to work on, so see how each one changes what you can do.

pages.title: Cute Christmas Bull Difference
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Find seven differences in each pair of holiday pictures in Cute Christmas Bull Difference. Compare the scenes and click the details that have changed. Work quickly, because each of the eight levels gives you one minute to find the full set.

pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Practice arithmetic in 1+1. Look at the numbers and the sign between them, then click the answer that completes the equation. Check whether you’re adding or subtracting before making your choice and use what you worked out on the next problem.

pages.title: Football.io
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Collect yellow balls and steer around white ones in Football.io. Look out for transparent balls while you move, and grab bonuses when they appear. Some make you faster, restore a life, or slow down enemy balls so you can get to the next yellow one.

pages.title: Truck Driver Cargo Game
pages.creator: gamehub
pages.description: Carry loads in Truck Driver Cargo Game. Choose a transport truck and keep it under control as you travel to the delivery point. Pay attention to the road ahead and give yourself room to steer the larger vehicle while you finish each hauling job.

pages.title: Spot The Differences
pages.creator: SNSHUB
pages.description: Compare two photographs in Spot The Differences and find five details that have changed. Scan the pictures a section at a time and click a difference when you see it. Look at small objects as well as the main subject before moving on to another pair.

pages.title: Number Shapes
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Drag each numeral into its matching space in Number Shapes. Look at the outline and compare its curves and straight edges with the numbers you can move. Find the right spot for each one as you practice recognizing how the numerals are written.

pages.title: Moto Maniac 2
pages.creator: IriySoft
pages.description: Ride along a bridge under construction in Moto Maniac 2. A drone lights the way, but you still have to get past obstacles without hitting your head or falling off the bridge. Balance the bike in the dark and try to finish the run as quickly as you can.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter 2020
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Rescue raccoon cubs by popping colored bubbles in Bubble Shooter 2020. Aim a bubble at others of the same color and make matches to open the board. Keep clearing the clusters between the mother raccoon and the cubs the monkey has taken.

pages.title: Not One
pages.creator: Zibotronic
pages.description: Defend Earth from Martians in Not One. Tap to fire and watch where the invaders are moving so you can line up the next shot. Keep the attackers from getting through as you work to beat your previous score.

pages.title: Billie Eilish Makeover
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Put together a look for the singer in Billie Eilish Makeover. Browse the wardrobe and try pieces that fit the style you want to create. Experiment with different combinations as her stylist and settle on a finished outfit that makes the look your own.

pages.title: F1 Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Rebuild six race car pictures in F1 Jigsaw Puzzle. Choose a 2-by-3, 3-by-4, or 4-by-6 layout and drag each piece into place. Follow the outlines and colors on the cars to work out which fragments belong together.

pages.title: Heart Balloons Block Collapse
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Click groups of at least three matching blocks in Heart Balloons Block Collapse. Use the projection box to see what a clear is worth and look for ways to make bigger groups. Use power-ups when the blocks pile up and try to keep them below the top of the board.

pages.title: Expert Goalkeeper
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Move the gloves to block penalty kicks in Expert Goalkeeper. Watch where the ball is headed and tap to get the gloves into position before it reaches the goal. Save more shots to earn funds for new gloves and see how long you can keep the streak going.

pages.title: FlipSurf.io
pages.creator: Umami Games
pages.description: Race across the ocean in FlipSurf.io. Speed up on the water, tap to flip in the air, and aim for a clean landing to get ahead. Try different characters and tracks, and look for flip boosters as you work on landing your tricks.

pages.title: Super Stunt Police Bike Simulator 3D
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Ride a police motorcycle through the city in Super Stunt Police Bike Simulator 3D. Try jumps off buildings and take on timed challenges to earn cash. Use what you earn to unlock more bikes and take another one out to see how it handles your stunts.

pages.title: Robot Spider Transport
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Take on combat missions in Robot Spider Transport. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, transform your police robot into its spider form, and fire at enemy machines. Fight through each area and look for the next checkpoint as you work toward completing the mission.

pages.title: Christmas Freecell Solitaire
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Build your foundations from ace to king in Christmas Freecell Solitaire. Use the free cells to hold cards while you uncover the ones you need. Think about what you’ll move next before filling a free cell, so you still have room to rearrange the layout.

pages.title: Algerian Solitaire
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Build eight foundations in Algerian Solitaire. For each suit, build one pile up from ace and another down from king. Move cards from the reserve or tableau when they fit, and decide when to draw more cards if the current layout gives you no useful move.

pages.title: Cozy Christmas Difference
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Find seven differences in each pair of holiday scenes in Cozy Christmas Difference. Compare the pictures and click the details that change. Each of the ten levels gives you one minute, so move on to another part of the image if one spot is holding you up.

pages.title: Super Fast Motorbikes Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Choose one of 12 motorcycle pictures in Super Fast Motorbikes Jigsaw. Set the puzzle to 25, 49, or 100 pieces, then follow the colors and outlines to bring the image back together. Try a different bike or increase the piece count on a favorite.

pages.title: Zombie Challenge
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Take out the zombies with as few shots as you can in Zombie Challenge. Look at where the targets are standing and aim for a shot that reaches more than one. Check what’s still on the board before firing again and try to clear the whole group.

pages.title: Magical Wizard Match 3
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Line up three or more blocks of the same color in Magical Wizard Match 3. Keep making matches to build your score and watch the meter on the left. The game ends if it drops too low, so look for another clear as soon as the pieces settle.

pages.title: Alien Shoot Zombies
pages.creator: Darko Veljovic
pages.description: Aim an alien’s gun at the undead in Alien Shoot Zombies. Look at the layout before firing, since the number of shots is limited. Use the openings around the obstacles to reach targets, and check what’s still standing before you spend another shot.

pages.title: Wooden Puzzle Game
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Drag wooden blocks onto the board in Wooden Puzzle Game. Fill a row or column to clear it and make room for the next pieces. Leave space for awkward shapes, because the game ends when none of the available pieces can fit.

pages.title: Spidy Soccer
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Play soccer as Spidy in Spidy Soccer. Use the arrow keys to move into position, Z to pass or defend, and X to shoot. Keep track of where the ball is going and look for an opening to send it past the opposing players.

pages.title: Candy Puzzle Block
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Fit candy shapes into the grid in Candy Puzzle Block. Complete a row or column to clear it and earn points, then use the space for more pieces. Plan where larger shapes could fit before filling up the small gaps around them.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Learn Shapes
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Help Hazel learn to recognize shapes in Baby Hazel Learn Shapes. Fit pieces into a puzzle, bake cookies in different shapes, and choose beads for a necklace. Then go to the garden and look for the same shapes in the playground equipment.

pages.title: Bus Parking
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Steer a bus into its space in Bus Parking. Leave room for the back of the bus to follow as you turn, then straighten out before finishing the maneuver. Work through the different parking levels and try the available bus skins.

pages.title: Walk Crazy
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Cross a busy road in Walk Crazy. Hold the controls to change your walking speed and use the gaps between cars to stay clear of traffic. Pick up coins when it’s safe to do so and see how long you can avoid a collision.

pages.title: Fill Maze
pages.creator: FreeGames.org
pages.description: Slide a ball through the corridors in Fill Maze. The ball leaves color wherever it goes, so look for branches you haven’t reached yet and work out how to get back to them. Cover the whole layout to complete each of the 80 puzzles.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Tree House
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Search three rooms for Hazel’s lost ball in Baby Hazel Tree House. Look around the different spaces and help her interact with the things she finds. Try the activities and see what surprises are hiding in the tree house as the search goes on.

pages.title: Water Car Surfing 3D
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Drive across water and reach checkpoints in Water Car Surfing 3D. Use WASD to steer and adjust your speed as the course turns. Watch where the next checkpoint is before you commit to a turn, then keep going until you’ve finished the level.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Toddler Vaccines
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Join a doctor’s visit in Dotted Girl Toddler Vaccines. Help Dotted Girl and her toddler through the appointment by working with the medical tools as they’re needed. Follow each step to get the little one ready for her shots and finish the visit.

pages.title: BTS Kids Car Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Color pictures of cars in BTS Kids Car Coloring. Choose a shade from the palette and apply it to the part of the car you want to paint. Change colors for the wheels or other details, or try a different combination on another car.

pages.title: Funny Faces Match3
pages.creator: Mobi2Fun
pages.description: Match groups of faces in Funny Faces Match3. Look for identical expressions you can bring together, then use the layout that remains to find another match. Keep comparing the shapes and colors as the board changes so you can spot the next group.

pages.title: Forsake the Rake
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Search an underground lab in Forsake the Rake. You and a friend have traced the mystery from a forest to the abandoned facility. Explore its ten levels and stay alert for the creature as you look for answers about what happened there.

pages.title: Cookie Run
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Help Daredevil and his friends escape the Witch’s oven in Cookie Run. Use W or Up to jump, and S or Down to slide under obstacles. Keep moving through the World of Cookies and decide quickly whether to go above or below the next hazard.

pages.title: Ten Blocks
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Drag numbered blocks into place in Ten Blocks. Arrange them so the numbers add up to ten in a row or column to score points. Check the totals you’ve already made and plan where the next piece can help you finish another line.

pages.title: Princesses Castle Ball
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare Ellie, Annie, and Ariel for the annual ball in Princesses Castle Ball. Choose a dress for each princess and add flowers or other accessories that suit it. Try different pieces before deciding what each guest should wear to the event.

pages.title: Parking Block
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Slide parked vehicles aside to open an exit in Parking Block. Find which cars are keeping yours in place, then move the other ones first when you need more room. Clear a path through the crowded lot and slide your car out.

pages.title: Lumberjack River Exit
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Get a raft home in Lumberjack River Exit. Move the things blocking the river, including logs, boats, and animals, until there’s a clear way out. Work out which obstruction has room to move first, then use the space it leaves to free the raft.

pages.title: Easter Breaker Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Clear matching groups from the grid in Easter Breaker Game. Click a group of at least two identical symbols and use the new layout to plan the next clear. A single symbol costs a life, so check what will be left behind before making your move.

pages.title: Crazy Colors
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Guide a ball through colored obstacles in Crazy Colors. Tap to move it and pass through a section that matches the ball. Its color can change along the way, so check it before the next obstacle. A wrong match sends you back to the start.

pages.title: Breaking News With Blondie
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Get a television reporter ready to go live in Breaking News With Blondie. Choose her makeup first, then browse the dresses for something to wear on camera. See how the outfit works with the makeup and put the finishing touches on her broadcast look.

pages.title: Sea Party
pages.creator: Duchnowski
pages.description: Match at least three sea animals of the same color in Sea Party. Look for groups you can clear, then check the new layout for another combination. Keep making matches as the pieces change and see how high you can take your score.

pages.title: Princess Juliet Fashion Trouble
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Help put the castle back in order in Princess Juliet Fashion Trouble. An evil witch has wrecked the preparations, so work through the mess and get things ready again. Find what needs to be restored and prepare the clothes before the party.

pages.title: Ice Queen New Year Makeover
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Get the Ice Queen ready for a New Year celebration in Ice Queen New Year Makeover. Try the makeover options and choose details for her holiday look. Put the pieces together and see how your choices suit the outfit before the celebration begins.

pages.title: Finger Stick
pages.creator: Ixel Games
pages.description: Tap a spinner to flip it upright in Finger Stick. Watch how it moves after your touch and see whether it settles standing up. Try again when it lands on its side and adjust the timing of your touch to get a better result.

pages.title: Arrow Master
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Fire arrows into open spaces in Arrow Master. Watch the arrows already on the target and time the next shot so it doesn’t hit one of them. Keep finding room for the remaining arrows as the safe gaps get harder to use.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Doggies
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Piece together dog pictures in Jigsaw Puzzle Doggies. Look for edges, fur markings, and background details that carry across neighboring pieces. Use those clues to restore one image, then pick another dog picture for a new puzzle.

pages.title: Unblock It
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Slide the surrounding pieces out of the way in Unblock It. Work out which pieces have to move first to open a route for the yellow block. Use the room they leave to shift the remaining obstacles, then slide the yellow piece out.

pages.title: Wonder Woman Movie
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Help a superhero film her scenes in Wonder Woman Movie. Start downtown, where you’ll help her deal with the villains, then choose an outfit from her wardrobe for the role. Work through the movie’s settings and give her a look that fits each scene.

pages.title: Princess Dress Designer
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Create three dresses for a friend in Princess Dress Designer. Think about the event each dress is for before choosing how it should look. Put your own spin on each design as the princess takes on the role of her friend’s tailor.

pages.title: Princess Dentist
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Choose Elsa, Ariel, Cinderella, or Rapunzel for an appointment in Princess Dentist. Look at the problems causing her toothache and use the dental tools to treat them. Work through the appointment with the patient you picked and finish caring for her teeth.
